title: Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) Device Map Schema
description: Per-platform allowlist/denylist of devfreq devices to be exercised by the DVFS Checkbox test.

allowlist.description: Devfreq devices that should be tested.

denylist.description: Device names that must be excluded even if they would otherwise be picked up automatically.

deviceType.description: Category of the devfreq device. Defaults to "other" when omitted.

governor.description: Devfreq governor name (e.g. userspace, powersave, performance, simple_ondemand).

device_name.description: Name of the devfreq device as it appears under /sys/class/devfreq, or another platform-specific identifier.

sysfs_path.description: Optional absolute sysfs path override, used when the device's devfreq node is not exposed directly under /sys/class/devfreq.

governors.description: List of governors expected to be available and tested for this device.
